automations.name: issue-link gate
automations.what: holds an external PR until its author is assigned to an issue it links; assignment reopens a gate-closed PR. A failed run is usually a PR it blocked, so this row shows only that the gate is running
automations.cadence: on each external PR change and each issue assignment

automations.name: labeling
automations.what: labels each new issue and PR, and flags submissions that don't follow CONTRIBUTING.md
automations.cadence: on each new issue or PR

automations.name: duplicate detection
automations.what: points out when a new issue duplicates an existing one

automations.name: auto-close
automations.what: closes issues marked as duplicates, and issues still missing a reproducible example after 7 days of author inactivity

automations.name: bug investigation
automations.what: investigates new bug reports filed by maintainers and posts findings

automations.name: CI failure analysis
automations.what: explains failed test and static-analysis runs on pull requests

automations.name: maintainer commands
automations.what: `/marvin` on an issue or PR asks the bot to act; `/tidy` hides resolved review threads

automations.name: upgrade checks
automations.what: runs the test suite against the newest dependency releases and opens an issue when it fails

automations.name: release publishing
automations.what: publishes fastmcp-slim, then fastmcp-tasks, fastmcp-remote, and fastmcp to PyPI when a release is cut

automations.name: docs deploy
automations.what: deploys gofastmcp.com when the published docs change
